assertions.subject: Long QT syndrome
assertions.quote: normal QT interval is less than 400 to 440 milliseconds

assertions.subject: Torsades de Pointes
assertions.quote: A prolonged QT interval presents an imminent risk for serious ventricular arrhythmias, including Torsades de Pointes

assertions.subject: ventricular tachycardia
assertions.quote: A prolonged QT interval presents an imminent risk for serious ventricular arrhythmias, including Torsades de Pointes, ventricular tachycardia, and ventricular fibrillation

assertions.subject: ventricular fibrillation
assertions.quote: A prolonged QT interval presents an imminent risk for serious ventricular arrhythmias, including Torsades de Pointes, ventricular tachycardia, and ventricular fibrillation

assertions.subject: Short QT syndrome
assertions.quote: A short QT interval ( less than 360 milliseconds) may be associated with hypercalcemia, acidosis, hyperkalemia, hyperthermia, or short QT syndrome
